Source: Exercising does not affect the loss of urine.
A 48-year-old woman, gravida 3 para 3, presents to the clinic with a 5-month history of intermittent loss of urine.
On pelvic examination, there is no dribbling of urine when the patient coughs.
Her urinary leaking occurs throughout the day and night, and she often has to get up to use the bathroom while asleep.
Her last menstrual period was 2 weeks ago.
Her urinalysis is unremarkable, and her postvoid residual volume is 40 mL.
She states that she often cannot make it to the bathroom in time once she senses a need to void.
